description: Defines API and data structures for file write-locks used by Git, including lockfile creation, management, and cleanup mechanisms.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with a specified timeout and mode, returning a file descriptor or -1 on failure.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with a specified timeout, default mode 0666.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile without timeout.

methods.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_mode
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile with specified mode.

methods.name: is_lock_file_locked
methods.description: Checks if the lockfile is currently active/locked.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_message
methods.description: Appends an error message regarding lock failure to a buffer.

methods.name: unable_to_lock_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the program if lock acquisition fails.

methods.name: fdopen_lock_file
methods.description: Associates a stdio stream with the lockfile.

methods.name: get_lock_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the lockfile.

methods.name: get_lock_file_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the lockfile.

methods.name: get_lock_file_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the lockfile.

methods.name: get_locked_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the file that is locked.

methods.name: close_lock_file_gently
methods.description: Closes the lockfile without removing it.

methods.name: commit_lock_file
methods.description: Commits the lockfile, closing and renaming it to final destination.

methods.name: commit_lock_file_to
methods.description: Renames the lockfile to a specified path.
